learning.title: Finding / incident
learning.does: Anchor the question to one synthetic resource or explicit compatible selection.
learning.cannot: A vague ticket or free-text instruction is not authority to change resources.
learning.evidence: Finding ID, control, revision and current status.
learning.example: The SSL story identifies one bucket; the SG story identifies one exact group.

learning.title: AI reasoning + selection
learning.does: Explain impact and choose a registered capability. Here reasoning is scripted MOCK.
learning.cannot: AI cannot grant approval, invent tools, expand the target set or execute arbitrary APIs.
learning.evidence: Bounded Explain / Investigate context and named capability.
learning.example: The network specialist chooses mock.sg-ssh; it does not produce a shell command.

learning.title: Capability registry
learning.does: Describe fixed inputs, supported resource/control and deterministic action.
learning.cannot: A catalogue label does not establish a live agent or implementation. Partial/planned remain explicit.
learning.evidence: Registered capability ID and fixed before/after parameters.
learning.example: Logging is partial and snapshot exposure is planned; neither pretends to remediate.

learning.title: Exact target / policy validation
learning.does: Check eligibility, exact frozen revisions and simulated actor authorization.
learning.cannot: Approval cannot authorize an unrelated target or override a denied actor.
learning.evidence: Frozen target list; stale and unauthorized refusal records.
learning.example: The unauthorized SG branch is DENIED with zero writes.

learning.title: Approve Once / Reject
learning.does: A human consumes one decision for this exact proposal.
learning.cannot: A repeated click, model choice, ticket or scheduled event cannot create new authority.
learning.evidence: Proposal ID, recorded decision and consumed state.
learning.example: Reject records a run with zero writes and unchanged finding status.

learning.title: Deterministic executor
learning.does: Apply only the fixed registered simulated operation to approved scope.
learning.cannot: No arbitrary provider commands; no repeat of recorded targets on same-run resume.
learning.evidence: Run ID, processed cursor and target-level simulated write counts.
learning.example: The SSH tool removes public TCP22 rules and retains unrelated ingress.

learning.title: Provider readback
learning.does: Record whether simulated provider parameters match the intended change.
learning.cannot: A successful operation or matching provider response is not a compliance verdict.
learning.evidence: Separate provider operation and readback entries.
learning.example: The mismatch branch reports SIMULATED PARAMETERS MATCH but still needs review.

learning.title: Independent compliance
learning.does: Evaluate the control separately and distinguish compliant from unresolved.
learning.cannot: A provider success cannot be promoted to VERIFIED when compliance fails.
learning.evidence: COMPLIANT, NON_COMPLIANT or NOT EVALUATED independent result.
learning.example: Provider match with failed compliance yields NEEDS_REVIEW and leaves the incident open.

learning.title: Audit / incident update
learning.does: Link the exact finding, proposal and run before recording a business outcome.
learning.cannot: Missing or unrelated later target history cannot close an incident or contaminate its export.
learning.evidence: Matching incident audit and local JSON record.
learning.example: MOCK works offline because contracts and safety decisions are demonstrable without AWS. It is not live or durable provider proof.
